evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: robots.txt has no Content-Signal declaration. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.detail: WARN: Blocked or challenged: ChatGPT-User (HTTP 403), OAI-SearchBot (HTTP 403), and PerplexityBot (HTTP 403). Sent with each bot's user agent from Elmo's address, so sites that verify bots by IP may treat the real bots differently. Fix: Mak

evidence.label: Clean Redirects
evidence.detail: FAIL: Meta-refresh or JavaScript redirects on 3 pages, which many agents don't follow. Fix: Use server-side 301/308 redirects with at most two hops instead of meta-refresh or JavaScript redirects.

evidence.label: Real 404 Pages
evidence.detail: FAIL: A missing page returns HTTP 200 (a soft 404). Fix: Return HTTP 404 for pages that don't exist. A 200 "soft 404" makes agents treat an error page as content.

evidence.label: Content Without JavaScript
evidence.detail: FAIL: Homepage: 0 characters of text and 0 headings in the server HTML. 3 of 4 pages have little or no text or headings without JavaScript. Fix: Server-render your main content. Most AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so a client-rendered sh

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (4 pages checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (4 pages checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: /llms.txt returned HTTP 200 with an HTML page. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: llms-full.txt
evidence.detail: WARN: /llms-full.txt returns an HTML page. Fix: Publish /llms-full.txt with the full text of your key pages or docs in one markdown file.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: The homepage has no Organization JSON-LD. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Entity Links (sameAs)
evidence.detail: FAIL: The Organization has no sameAs links. Fix: List your official profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, Crunchbase, Wikipedia, X) in the Organization's `sameAs`, so models tie your site to the right entity.

evidence.label: Page Structured Data
evidence.detail: WARN: Sampled pages only use Product. Fix: Mark up pages with the schema.org type that fits them: Article or BlogPosting, Product or SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList.

evidence.label: Page Metadata
evidence.detail: FAIL: title missing on 3 pages, meta description missing on 3 pages, canonical missing on 3 pages, lang missing on 3 pages, og:image missing on 4 pages, and og:type missing on 3 pages. Fix: Give every page a unique title, a meta description

headline: AI crawlers face 403 blocks and empty pages without JavaScript on shopee.vn.

findings.title: AI bots blocked with HTTP 403
findings.why: ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot receive HTTP 403 responses when requesting the site.
findings.fix: Allow verified AI search and user bots to access the site without HTTP 403 blocks.

findings.title: Pages are empty without JavaScript
findings.why: The homepage server HTML has 0 characters of text and 0 headings, and 3 of 4 pages lack non-JS content.
findings.fix: Server-render main page content so crawlers that do not run JavaScript can read it.

findings.title: Missing page titles and metadata
findings.why: Three sampled pages lack titles, meta descriptions, canonicals, and lang tags, and the homepage has only 6 words.
findings.fix: Add unique titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, and lang attributes to every page.

findings.title: No Organization structured data or entity links
findings.why: The homepage lacks Organization JSON-LD and sameAs links, and no JSON-LD was found on read pages.
findings.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with name, url, logo, description, contact details, and official sameAs links.

findings.title: No prices, contact details, or valid llms.txt
findings.why: Read text contains no prices or contact details, and /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt return HTML pages.
findings.fix: Include visible prices and contact details in text and publish a valid markdown /llms.txt file.

strengths.title: No third-party origins in the capture window
